stance_rationale: Core performance, walk-forward schedule, Harvey gate, and covariance checks are mostly defensible, but the judge draft over-promotes several unresolved gates into PASS/PASS_WITH_NOTE. Tail gate, AX-008 triangulation, AX-001 role honesty, and Codex rebuttal handling need revision before this verdict can stand.

scenario_rule_audit.replacement_evidence: Request and package frame Iter 11 as an optimizer-only replacement/mutation of STR_1699 weighting. Judge nevertheless recommends AB integration and sends Sequential Admission TDC to Governor, so replacement-vs-addition boundaries are blurred.

statistical_robustness_audit.point_estimate_vs_robust_tradeoff: Iter11 pre-LB 5-spec t_NW 4.45~4.55 and DSR_post 4.0731 pass. Current PG2 D scenario has Harvey_t_FF5 2.1143 and DSR_post 2.5107, so baseline point SR is weak; however this does not cure tail, AX-008, or role-honesty failures.

critical_concerns.description: Gate 6 is labeled PASS_WITH_NOTE even though the judge draft itself records cvar_pass=false and cvar95_daily_realized=0.0259 > 0.025. Forge also labels a 5% quantile/sqrt(21) as CVaR, while optimizer CVaR proxy is 0.0297 and reproduced pre-LB monthly CVaR/sqrt(21) is about 0.0295; this is not a clean tail PASS.

AX-008 triangulation is miscounted. Base context requires Forge + Codex + Architect with at least 2 PASS; this package has Forge PASS, Codex optimizer REJECT, no Architect artifact, and Judge counting its own harness as a substitute source.

Role Honesty Audit grants AX-001 v2 PASS without the required defense evidence. Risk package shows alpha CRISIS mean_ic=-0.1727 and thin CRISIS samples; judge uses whole-composite OOS MDD relief versus PG2, not defense sleeve crisis_alpha + Core MDD relief + bad/normal IC ratio.

Codex critique handling is too deferential. Only optimizer Codex response is present in this WT, and inherited alpha/risk codex rounds are REJECT with RF-A1 subperiod stability and DSR failures; judge reduces Codex objections mostly to optimizer CVaR and accepts QLead rebuttals without independent evidence.

Replacement versus Sequential Admission is muddled. If this is a replacement-style upgrade, the judge should compare replacement SR/CAGR/MDD/Harvey/DSR directly and not route Sequential Admission TDC as if this were an additive sleeve gate.

Artifact lineage is not clean enough for a final PASS: the required qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260426_004 path is absent, while stage_artifacts/WT_D20260426_004 uses symlinks to parent WT_D20260425_010 alpha/covariance. This may be acceptable inheritance, but the judge verdict should state that explicitly rather than imply direct WT-local artifacts.

Liquidity mandate remains internally inconsistent: base hard constraint is 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW, request.json says 5e7 KRW, optimizer challenge note calls 5e7 WT-specific, while judge claims 2e8 PASS without an independent selected-schedule liquidity audit.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv is a real 216-date schedule from 2006-01-01 to 2023-12-01; equity names <=20, max equity weight is approximately 0.20, sum weights error is about 1.33e-15, and annualized turnover is below 600%.
alpha_scores.parquet under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260426_004 is a symlinked time-series artifact with 70,065 rows, 240 dates, and 773 tickers from 2004-01-01 to 2023-12-01.
covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.003300942 and condition number 24.3401, satisfying the post-shrink condition check.
Judge lockbox harness reproduces n_days=550, period 2024-01-23 to 2026-04-26, SR=1.8894, MDD=-0.2898, total_return=1.9886.
Harvey 5-spec pre-LB t_NW values all exceed 2.95, and the stated DSR_post_penalty=4.0731 is consistent with subtracting the 20-candidate penalty from FF5 DSR 5.0731.
unresolved_disputes: Which CVaR definition governs Gate 6: optimizer monthly-tail mean/sqrt(21), Forge 5% quantile/sqrt(21), judge stated 0.0259, or daily lockbox CVaR from the judge harness.
Whether CASH should remain excluded from max_names and per-name bounds, since several dates have 21 rows including CASH but only 20 equities.
Whether WT-specific liquidity 5e7 can override the base 2e8 hard mandate, and whether selected holdings were audited PIT by date.
Whether AB integration is a Governor scenario only or part of the Judge verdict; the current draft mixes replacement and integration logic.
Whether lockbox FF5 regression is truly unavailable, given local kr_factor_returns_v2.parquet extends to 2026-03-04.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that strong Forge/Judge performance evidence permits PASS_WITH_NOTE despite unresolved tail-cap measurement, Codex REJECT, missing Architect triangulation, and unproven AX-001 defense contribution.
rebuttal_required: Recompute Gate 6 with one declared CVaR formula and update the gate to PASS or FAIL, not PASS_WITH_NOTE over cvar_pass=false.
Provide an Architect pass or another valid AX-008 source; do not count Judge self-measurement as Architect.
Show AX-001 v2 defense metrics directly: crisis_alpha, Core-vs-Defense MDD relief, and bad/normal IC ratio.
Attach or summarize the full alpha/risk/optimizer Codex critique rebuttal matrix with evidence, especially RF-A1, DSR, and subperiod stability.
Clarify replacement versus integration admission rule and remove Sequential Admission TDC unless this is explicitly an additive-sleeve scenario.
Resolve the 2e8 versus 5e7 liquidity threshold and state inherited symlink artifacts as inherited, not WT-local originals.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge and Judge harness support performance, but Codex is REJECT and Architect is absent. The judge draft converts unresolved objections into notes, which is exactly the echo-chamber failure mode AX-008 is meant to prevent.
